predictions.current_behavior: A contract with a present but non-object certification_gates field can take the legacy readout path.
predictions.expected_fix: Presence of certification_gates is final intent and must disable legacy opt-out, regardless of the field value.
predictions.required_regression: A contract with certification_gates=[] and otherwise valid legacy opt-out inputs fails closed.

predictions.current_behavior: Checkpoint/report binding reconstructs aggregate counters and repros but does not bind divergence_classes.
predictions.expected_fix: The durable checkpoint aggregate derives divergence_classes from per-game counters using the same classifier as build_report, and certification rejects any report disagreement.
predictions.required_regression: Fabricated or omitted report divergence_classes fail checkpoint/report binding.

predictions.current_behavior: Parseable JSON values that are not checkpoint records are silently skipped, including in the middle of a JSONL file.
predictions.expected_fix: Every nonblank parseable line must be a checkpoint object with the exact checkpoint schema; any schema/type mismatch is fatal and no bytes are rewritten.
predictions.required_regression: Mid-file and final {}, 42, and [] records fail closed, while only an unparseable final torn write remains repairable.
